environment: This is a Rust cargo workspace (nightly toolchain) for the Canary programming language compiler `cyc` and its tooling; `cargo build/check/test/run/fmt/clippy` and `mdbook build/serve` in `docs/` are routine and safe.
Commits are checked by cocogitto (`cog verify`) through `.githooks/commit-msg`; `python3 scripts/docs.py` manages ADR numbers and the ADR index.
Long or repeated runs (benches, stress loops) belong on `ssh filaco.dev` in a worktree under `~/Projects/canary/.claude/worktrees/`, never on the Mac.
